description: This Java source file defines the BinaryProtocolServer class which implements a TCP server proxy for the rusEfi engine tuning software. It facilitates communication between the console and other tuning tools by proxying binary protocol commands over a TCP socket. The class handles incoming connections, processes protocol commands, and forwards data accordingly, acting as an intermediary for diagnostic and control commands.

classes.name: BinaryProtocolServer
classes.description: A TCP server class that creates a proxy for the rusEfi console, enabling simultaneous connection of multiple tuning tools by relaying binary protocol commands over TCP.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the TCP proxy server, accepting incoming connections and spawning threads for each client.

methods.name: runProxy
methods.description: Handles the proxying logic for a connected client socket, reading protocol commands, verifying CRCs, and responding appropriately.

methods.name: swap16
methods.description: Utility method to swap byte order of a 16-bit short value.
